== Summary ==
Official Players Committee remade full face for [[Haven (PC 2024 D-E1 card)|Haven (PC Errata 3)]], displaying the D-E1 mark. This is not a scan of the original Decipher printing.

The displayed GIF has the same visible card text, artwork, title/type layout and D-E1 mark as [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/48d57c17d760f4bb25b4d55459f709eef5f8cb82/Images-HT/starwars/CloudCity-Light/hires/haven.png the pinned official PC source PNG] committed 2024-01-27T03:51:38Z. The native GIF and pinned source PNG are both745×1039 pixels and decoded-RGB pixel-identical; the file encodings differ. This source occurrence does not establish the first publication day.

Existing Wiki image bytes retained unchanged: SHA-256 <code>4c9da93c103d500a98d9053696a613292e107200b7eef39e88617eca8e8c77ff</code>. Original card copyright is printed on the source face; the original design is by Decipher, with the corrected PC rendition credited separately.
